revenue.source: UNP Q4/FY2025 earnings release (investor.unionpacific.com), Total operating revenues

operating_income.source: UNP Q4/FY2025 earnings release, Operating income

d_and_a.source: UNP FY2025 10-K (acc. 0000100885-26-000037) cash flow statement, Depreciation

capex.source: UNP FY2025 earnings release, Cash used in capital investments

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: history grew 0.5%/1.1% in FY24/FY25; modest acceleration from volume plus ~2-3% pricing; fades to 3%. Does not model the pending Norfolk Southern merger.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 EBIT margin 40.2% (9,846/24,510), up from 37.7% in FY2023; slight gain from productivity.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2025 effective rate ~22.1% (pretax 9,166, NI 7,138); 23% for federal plus state.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 15.5% incl. lease buyouts, FY2024 14.2%, FY2023 15.0%; 14.5% as normalized.

wacc.source: Assumption: beta ~1.0, rf ~4.2%, ERP ~5% gives cost of equity ~9%; after-tax debt ~4%; ~15% debt weight gives ~7.5%.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP/inflation-like growth, below risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: UNP Q4/FY2025 release: debt 31,814 (1,520 current + 30,294 long-term, excl. leases) less cash and equivalents 1,266; no short-term investments found

diluted_shares.source: UNP Q4/FY2025 release, full-year weighted average diluted shares (millions)
